notes: πάντων takes the whole *of all kinds* with the case preposition, the article being `unrepresented` for want of an English determiner (rules 21, 23); κακῶν keeps the second *of*.
The head of ἀπεπλανήθησαν is on *astray* under rule 17's resultative clause, *led* being the generic support verb; the alternative is named in the unit note.
*after* stays with ὀρεγόμενοι as the English verb's own particle, no Greek preposition being expressed for rule 36 to assign it to.
